name: store-cohort-audit
title: Store Cohort Audit
problem: Did a regional operational metric improve within comparable stores, or only because the store mix changed?
limitations: Four hundred original store-period-day count rows cover 20 fictional stores over ten days before and after. Volume shifts toward lower-baseline stores while each latent completion probability increases by 0.03. One sparse store fails the minimum of 50 accepted orders per period. A fixed equal-store reference mix is supplied independently of observed outcomes. Rates are completed orders divided by accepted orders. Standardization answers a fixed-store-mix question rather than the order-weighted aggregate. Bootstrap resamples whole store pairs and is descriptive over 19 supported stores. No intervention or causal field result is asserted.
